Audit parallel RNG invariance across core counts

Source: R/audit-parallel-rng.R
check_parallel_rng.Rd

Verifies that a stochastic pipeline produces identical results when executed sequentially (cores = 1) versus in parallel (cores = 2, etc.). Supports either a custom runner(cores, seed) function to audit your own parallel code directly, or a task function fun evaluated via statci_parallel_apply().

Usage

check_parallel_rng(
  runner = NULL,
  fun = NULL,
  X = seq_len(8L),
  cores = c(1L, 2L),
  seed = 42L,
  tolerance = 0,
  ...
)

Arguments

runner

Optional function of signature function(cores, seed) that executes the stochastic computation using cores workers and master seed. If provided, check_parallel_rng() tests whether runner yields identical outputs across all values of cores.

fun

Optional task function function(i, ...) evaluated over X via statci_parallel_apply() when runner is NULL.

X

Sequence or list of inputs for fun (defaults to seq_len(8L)).

cores

Integer vector of core counts to compare (default c(1L, 2L)). Must contain at least two distinct values.

seed

Integer seed passed to each run.

tolerance

Numeric comparison tolerance (0 checks bit-for-bit exactness via identical()).

...

Additional arguments forwarded to fun.

Value

An S3 object of class "statci_parallel_rng" with status ("pass" or "fail"), comparisons tibble, identical_all, max_abs_diff, cores_tested, and seed.

Examples

# Passes: deterministic L'Ecuyer stream per task
ok <- check_parallel_rng(
  runner = function(cores, seed) {
    unlist(statci_parallel_apply(1:6, function(i) mean(rnorm(20)), cores = cores, seed = seed))
  },
  cores = c(1L, 2L),
  seed = 123L
)
ok$status
#> [1] "pass"
